reference: User-approved miniature bakery reference, October 2026; use as aesthetic guidance, not as a reusable sprite

visualLanguage.guidanceMix: 70% miniature / 30% pixel character (art direction, not numeric image processing)
visualLanguage.lighting: soft consistent upper-left daylight; baked shading, no dramatic cast shadows
visualLanguage.silhouette: clear readable roof, chimney, doors, windows at final on-map size
visualLanguage.pixelTreatment: controlled pixel-edge definition; no blur or aggressive posterization; no heavy black outlines

camera.projection: match existing Cartographer isometric projection and camera orientation

assetContract.dimensions: consistent across four views of a design; record width/height in art registration
assetContract.display: pixel-crisp edges; verify at native map scale and browser zoom
assetContract.groundAnchor: same logical ground plane for every view; visual foot must align with prefab footprint
assetContract.safeMargins: allow roof/chimney overhang but avoid excessive transparent padding
assetContract.footprint: geometry remains authoritative; artwork cannot change collision or placement

checks: roof and chimney complete in every view
foundation and entrance meet the ground plane
occlusion with trees and walls remains correct

rollout.fallback: retain existing painted assets until each new four-view set is approved
rollout.plannedPatterns: must remain disabled until complete art registration
